title: Optimal estimation for Functional Linear Regression with Noisy Discretized Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.08671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we consider the scalar-on-function linear regression model under a realistic sampling scheme in which the functional covariates are observed on a regular grid and contaminated by additive noise. We propose a two-step estimation procedure: first, the underlying curves are reconstructed from the discrete noisy observations using a Fourier-based projection method; second, the slope function is estimated by a penalized least-squares criterion over finite-dimensional trigonometric spaces, with data-driven selection of the model dimension. We establish oracle-type inequalities for the prediction error, both with respect to the reconstructed curves and to the true latent curves. Under regularity assumptions on the slope function and polynomial decay of the eigenvalues of the covariate, we derive convergence rates for the prediction error and show that our estimator attains the minimax rate when the number of grid points is suff

translated_title: 含噪离散数据下函数线性回归的最优估计
translated_abstract: 本文研究了标量对函数的线性回归模型，采用一种现实的采样方案，即函数协变量在规则网格上被观测并受到加性噪声的污染。我们提出了一种两步估计方法：第一步，使用基于傅里叶的投影方法从离散含噪观测中重建潜在曲线；第二步，在有限维三角函数空间上通过惩罚最小二乘准则估计斜率函数，并进行数据驱动的模型维度选择。我们针对预测误差建立了oracle型不等式，既针对重建后的曲线，也针对真实的潜在曲线。在斜率函数的正则性假设和协变量特征值多项式衰减的条件下，我们导出了预测误差的收敛速度，并证明当网格点数量足够多时，我们的估计量达到了极小化极大最优速率。
tldr: 提出一种结合傅里叶投影曲线重建与惩罚最小二乘斜率估计的两步方法，在含噪离散采样下实现了函数线性回归预测误差的极小化极大最优速率。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-step procedure combining Fourier-based curve reconstruction with penalized least-squares slope estimation, achieving the minimax optimal prediction error rate for functional linear regression with noisy discretized data.
